prerequisites: fundamentals related to the applied physics

learning_outcomes.text: The students uses acquired engineering knowledge to solve complex problems related to design and to check function of mechanical systems used in machine industry
To design a mechanical system and to present a functionality of this system the student uses specific databases and specific engineering literature

The students uses acquired engineering knowledge to solve complex problems related to design and to check functionality of mechanical systems used in machine industry along with assessment of external influence of proposed solution
The students uses knowledge referring to automatics and robotics to design mechanical systems used in machine industry

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Strength of Materials: summarizing
Stress and Strain relations: Generalized Hooke's law
Finite Element Method: application to solve chosen problems (bars, beams, planar elements)
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the examination is 56.0%.

Da Silva, Vitor Dias: Mechanics and Strength of Materials. Springer 2006.

degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
